messages:
alex: Heads up — I hit a 404 from the onboarding flow when following the runtime guide link: https://docs.redwood.com/runtime/kv -> CloudFront 404. Can someone quick-claim? I'm swamped today.

maria: ugh, thanks for catching. @kb-bot can you surface the latest scan info for that path? :eyes:

kb-bot: Scan result (2026-03-21 15:10 UTC): detected 404 at /runtime/kv. Last content-modified: 2025-11-02 by jdoe. Related ticket created: DOCS-4123.

devon: do we know if this is a broken canonical doc path or a shortlink/asset mismatch?

alex: quick inspect suggests the onboarding snippet links to `/runtime/kv` but the actual doc lives at `/runtime/kv-cache`. `curl -I` returns 404.

sara: can you paste the curl output?

alex: ```bash
curl -I https://docs.redwood.com/runtime/kv
HTTP/2 404
server: CloudFront
date: Tue, 21 Mar 2026 15:12:34 GMT
```

devon: ok options: (A) add a tiny redirect from `/runtime/kv` -> `/runtime/kv-cache` at the CDN/origin level, (B) update the onboarding snippet to point to `/runtime/kv-cache`, or (C) both. For safety I lean C (snippet + redirect).

maria: I can do the snippet change PR and open the infra ticket for the redirect. PR will include a small note referencing DOCS-4123.

tj: +1 to that plan. If maria posts the PR I'll review quickly.

maria: taking it. will open PR in a few minutes and tag reviewers. Expecting a tiny markdown change in `onboarding/getting-started.md`.

alex: thanks — can you add @tj and @devon as reviewers on the PR? Also drop the kb-bot ticket number in the PR description.

maria: done — PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/888 (title: fix onboarding runtime link -> kv-cache). Added reviewers and linked DOCS-4123. :memo:

devon: quick note: once PR merges, we should run a docs staging preview smoke-check for that page (link preview + anchor sanity).

kb-bot: CI update: docs CI passing for PR #888. Staging preview produced: https://staging.docs.redwood.com/runtime/kv-cache (preview TTL 2h).

alex: perfect — thanks all. I won't block this; ping me if infra redirect can't be actioned soon. :wave:
